stage: Round 4, part 2 (amendment), declared before its first life: more speech. The arm fields256_p on the on-list set grown with train-other-500 (6,023 utterances, 7.1 hours), for 10 passes: 6,402,440 training steps against the 6,718,800 of part 1's 30 passes over 2.5 hours. Read after every pass, beside CTC controls at its parameter count, on six fresh founders. A reading, ungated.

data.corpus: LibriSpeech (CC BY 4.0, https://www.openslr.org/12), openslr.elda.org mirror; md5 train-clean-100 2a93770f6d5c6c964bc36631d331a522, train-clean-360 c0e676e450a7ff2f54aeade5171606fa, train-other-500 d1a0fd59409feb2c614ce4d30c387708, dev-clean 42e2234ba48799c1f50f24a7926300a1
data.list: words-2000.txt (md5 c3653e7a4315440a0088e2a3d0576081): the 2,000 most frequent words of the train-clean-100 and train-clean-360 transcripts with their counts (speech.py words)
data.train: every utterance of train-clean-100, train-clean-360 and train-other-500 whose every word is on the list, at most 12 seconds, in the corpus's order: 6,023 utterances, 640,244 steps, 25,701.8 seconds (train.npz md5 219c0b58e493a404d1256babe747c419)
data.held: the held-out utterances of part 1, the on-list utterances of dev-clean: 274 utterances, 23,378 steps (held.npz md5 ec4c2c1ae7689b3b0d198e27c1f0aa0c; the same audio as part 1, standardized per band on this part's training windows)
data.steps: 40 ms; a step hears its 24 latest 10 ms frames of 40 log-mel bands as a 40 by 24 image, less the window's mean, standardized per band on the training windows, clipped at 3 and scaled by 0.3 (speech.py prepare-listed --splits train-clean-100,train-clean-360,train-other-500)

brain.note: Brain.compose((40, 24), 29, backend='cpu', seed=s, learned_fields=64, modules=(256,), fields_motor=1.0, learning_surprise=False, **actor rates at zero): 1,285,724 parameters, the round 3 amendment's arm unchanged. 32 utterances heard side by side as streams, each batch from rest; 189 batches a pass, 1,890 batches a life. A reading after every pass (probe_every 189). The brain is saved at rest at every re-alignment and a stopped life continues from that save (speech.save_slot); Numba's threads per life are the box's to set (the library's rows give the same bits at any count).

teacher: The first 8 batches on the even split of each utterance's steps among its characters; every 8 batches a frozen copy answers the next 8 batches greedily and each utterance's steps go to its characters by CTC's forced alignment through the copy's log beliefs (ctc_path); each step taught the symbol on its path. 10 passes over the training utterances, each pass in its own seeded order.

modes: online: 10 passes in the brain's orders, one Adam step per utterance (rate 0.003), read after every pass
offline: shuffled epochs (rate 0.001), read after every epoch, to the stopping rule (patience 3) or 20 epochs; its reading after epoch 10 is the matched-exposure reading, its last reading the ceiling

readings: After every pass, on the 274 held-out utterances by the CTC reading, for every learner: characters; inserted, deleted and substituted characters per character; the letter from the sound, its emission given the letter, the word given its letters (speech.locate); words and exact transcripts against the open lexicon and matched to the list (each said word replaced by the nearest list word: vocabulary.Matcher); every held-out transcript and the 28 by 28 letter confusions (speech.confusions); seconds of training, re-alignment and reading.

gates.none: A reading beside part 1 at about equal training steps (10 passes over 7.1 hours here, 30 passes over 2.5 hours there): the letter from the sound, emission given the letter, deletions, characters and list-matched words after every pass for every learner, and the brain's gap to the offline transformer at its epoch 10, paired by founder. Six founders decide no gate.
gates.words: List-matched words are read for every learner at every pass, ungated. If any learner's mean characters at its last reading clear .60, a second decoding is read for every learner from the saved transcripts: the said letters with their spaces dropped, cut into list words by the fewest edits.

stop: One life per process; every life kept and reported; a life a lost machine stops continues from its last saved re-alignment, a control from its last whole pass. No setting changes after a life is read.
